svg.title: A Plan is a review record with no diff
svg.desc: A Plan is a review.json with kind plan and no base, head, or pull request. It keeps the deck, approvals and comments; a pinned relation names its stories.

text.tspan: A Plan is a review record with no diff

g.aria-label: Approval and comment records are unchanged: approvals name a slide and require a commit; comments target a slide or Item URN. Everything marked new is additive, but readers decode strictly, so an older one refuses it.
